title: Senior SAP Basis Consultant
description:
**Position Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior SAP BASIS Consultant** 
 with
 **7\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 in managing, architecture, and supporting complex SAP technical landscapes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end SAP system administration, HANA database management, system performance optimization, upgrades, and multi\-system integrations across both cloud and on\-premise deployments.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **System Administration \& Maintenance:** 
 Lead the installation, configuration, patching, kernel updates, and daily technical administration of complex SAP landscapes (ECC, S/4HANA, Solution Manager, BW, NetWeaver, PO/PI).
* **Database Management:** 
 Oversee SAP HANA (and traditional databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or Sybase ASE) administration, including memory management, backup/recovery strategies, high availability (HA), disaster recovery (DR), and performance tuning.
* **Landscape Architecture \& Strategy:** 
 Design, implement, and maintain system landscapes, transport management systems (TMS), client strategy, and system refreshes/copies across multi\-tiered environments.
* **Upgrades \& Migrations:** 
 Lead OS/DB migrations, S/4HANA conversion projects, system copies, and application of Support Package Stacks (SPS) and Enhancement Packs (EhP).
* **Performance Monitoring \& Tuning:** 
 Utilize SAP EarlyWatch Alerts (EWA), Wily Introscope, and CCMS to proactively monitor system health, optimize workload parameters, and perform root\-cause analysis (RCA) on performance bottlenecks.
* **Security \& Governance:** 
 Manage user access administration, GRC integration, SSO configuration, certificate installations, and enforce transport security and segregation of duties (SoD).
* **Cloud \& Hybrid Integration:** 
 Manage cloud hosting setups (AWS, Azure, GCP, or SAP RISE/Cloud ALM) and ensure seamless hybrid connectivity.



 Skills Required Specifically for a Senior SAP BASIS Consultant
 



 Technical Skills
 


* **Core SAP BASIS Administration:**
* SAP S/4HANA, ECC 6\.0, NetWeaver ABAP/JAVA stacks administration.
* Deep expertise in Transport Management System (TMS/eTMS) and ChaRM.
* SAP Solution Manager 7\.2 / SAP Cloud ALM setup, Monitoring, Focused Run, and EWA configuration.
* **HANA \& Database Administration:**
* SAP HANA Administration (HANA Studio, Cockpit, memory management, scale\-up/scale\-out architectures).
* Experience with traditional DBs (MS SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Sybase ASE).
* Database Backup, Restore, Point\-in\-Time Recovery, System Replication (HSR), and Disaster Recovery testing.
* **OS \& Platform Expertise:**
* High proficiency in Enterprise Linux (SUSE / RedHat Linux) and Windows Server operating systems.
* OS\-level shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell) for task automation.
* **System Lifecycle \& Upgrades:**
* Software Update Manager (SUM), Database Migration Option (DMO), and SPAM/SAINT execution.
* System Refreshes / Client Copies (BDLS execution, post\-refresh automation).
* **Security \& Integration:**
* Single Sign\-On (SSO) configuration (SAML 2\.0, Kerberos, SSL/TLS certificates).
* Interface administration (SAP PO/PI, Cloud Connector, RFCs, Web Dispatcher).



 Domain \& Professional Competencies
 


* **7\+ Years of Experience:** 
 Proven background as a primary technical owner for enterprise SAP environments.
* **Troubleshooting \& RCA:** 
 Strong diagnostic skills for analyzing short dumps, lock entries, system logs, and HANA trace files.
* **Disaster Recovery (DR):** 
 Expertise in setting up, maintaining, and testing high\-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* **Communication \& Mentorship:** 
 Ability to guide cross\-functional functional teams, interface with infrastructure teams, and mentor junior BASIS engineers.

title: Managed Services Engineer
description:
Managed Services Engineer – Microsoft 365 \& Backup/DR
   

 Cobweb Ahmedabad Delivery Centre \| On\-site, Ahmedabad \| 4\+ years experience
   

  

 ABOUT THIS ROLE
   

  

 Cobweb MENA FZ LLC is a Microsoft Solutions Partner headquartered in Dubai, UAE, delivering managed IT services, NOC/SOC monitoring, Microsoft 365, Azure and AI\-enablement solutions to SMB and mid\-market clients across the MENA region.
   

  

 The Cobweb Ahmedabad delivery centre operates under the Cobweb MENA FZ LLC – Eccentric Business Intelligence Pvt Ltd associated partnership, extending Cobweb's engineering capability into India. Eccentric Business Intelligence is a cross\-border advisory and technology services firm headquartered in Ahmedabad, with operations across India, the UAE and the USA.
   

  

 This role is based full\-time at the Ahmedabad delivery centre, working as part of Cobweb's service delivery function on the MENA client portfolio. Functional reporting is to the Services Director, Cobweb MENA FZ LLC; site and day\-to\-day administration sit with the Ahmedabad delivery centre management.
   

  

 It is a client\-facing engineering role, not a back\-office ticket queue. You will prepare and present Quarterly Business Reviews directly to client stakeholders.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 Microsoft 365 tenant management
   

 • Administer multiple client Microsoft 365 tenants — Exchange Online, Entra ID, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, user and mailbox lifecycle, and licensing.
   

 • Configure and maintain conditional access, MFA, mail flow rules and baseline security policies across the tenant estate.
   

 • Lead tenant\-to\-tenant and Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations end to end, including mailbox, data, DNS and identity cutover.
   

 • Monitor tenant health and licence utilisation, and recommend optimisation proactively.
   

  

 Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery
   

 • Own day\-to\-day Acronis (or equivalent) backup operations: job configuration, monitoring, failure remediation and restore testing.
   

 • Support client Business Continuity Plans, including RPO/RTO definitions, backup schedules and retention policies.
   

 • Coordinate periodic DR and failover/restore testing, and document outcomes.
   

  

 Quarterly Business Reviews
   

 • Build QBR packs covering service performance, ticket trends, patching and compliance, backup/DR posture, security posture and recommendations.
   

 • Present QBRs directly to client stakeholders and follow action items through to closure.
   

  

 RMM, PSA and automation
   

 • Work daily in RMM tooling (N\-able, Datto, ConnectWise Automate or equivalent) to monitor, patch and remediate across managed endpoints and servers.
   

 • Log and manage tickets in PSA/ITSM tooling (ConnectWise Manage, Autotask, HaloPSA, ServiceNow or equivalent) with accurate time capture and SLA adherence.
   

 • Automate recurring tasks in PowerShell (Graph API and Azure CLI an advantage) and maintain runbooks and SOPs.
   

  

 General service delivery
   

 • Deliver Level 2/3 support on escalated incidents within agreed SLAs, following ITIL\-aligned incident, change and problem management.
   

 • Collaborate with the Dubai service delivery and NOC/SOC teams.
   

 • Contribute to new client onboarding, including discovery, documentation and tooling deployment.
   

  

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
   

  

 • 4\+ years in an MSP, IT service desk or enterprise IT operations environment, with substantial hands\-on Microsoft 365 administration at scale.
   

 • Practical Acronis Cyber Protect or comparable backup platform experience, including restore and recovery operations.
   

 • Demonstrated experience leading tenant\-to\-tenant and Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations.
   

 • Proven ability to build and confidently deliver QBRs or similar client\-facing service reviews.
   

 • PowerShell scripting proficiency and solid RMM/PSA working knowledge.
   

 • Clear spoken and written English, with the confidence to engage MENA\-based clients directly.
   

 • Willingness to align working hours with Dubai/MENA business hours.
   

  

 MANDATORY CERTIFICATIONS
   

  

 Applications will only be considered from candidates holding both:
   

 • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS\-102\) or equivalent, and
   

 • A Microsoft security certification — SC\-300, SC\-200 or the retired MS\-500\.
   

  

 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

 Azure administration (virtual machines, Intune, basic networking); Mimecast or Proofpoint; Exclaimer; prior MSP experience serving MENA or multi\-country client portfolios; NOC/SOC\-monitored environments; ITIL v4 Foundation, AZ\-900, Acronis or Mimecast certifications.
   

  

 EDUCATION
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
   

  

 WHAT WE OFFER
   

  

 • A diverse, multi\-country MENA client base as part of a growing Microsoft Solutions Partner.
   

 • A genuinely client\-facing engineering role, not a back\-office ticket queue.
   

 • Structured career growth across the Cobweb – Eccentric associated partnership, with close collaboration alongside the Dubai leadership and technical teams.
   

 • An established office environment and local engineering team at the Ahmedabad delivery centre.
   

 • Support for continued Microsoft and vendor certification.
   

 • Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience and certification profile.
   

  

 HOW TO APPLY
   

  

 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Please include your Microsoft 365 certification numbers and a brief summary of the largest migration you have led.
   

  

 Recruitment for the Cobweb Ahmedabad delivery centre is managed by Eccentric Business Intelligence Pvt Ltd under the associated partnership with Cobweb MENA FZ LLC. Shortlisted candidates will be assessed through a technical discussion covering M365 administration, backup/DR operations and a QBR scenario walkthrough.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:
   

  

 –Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
   

  

 –Optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to support hyper\-scale systems.
   

  

 –Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
   

  

 –Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
   

  

 –Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
   

  

 –Design performance and load testing.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:
   

  

 –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
   

  

 –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
   

  

 –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting.
   

  

 –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:
   

  

 –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
   

  

 –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:
   

  

 –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
   

  

 –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness.
   

  

 –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
   

  

 Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:
   

  

 –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
   

  

 –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
   

  

 –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
   

  

 –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
   

  

 –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
   

  

 Compliance \& Security:
   

  

 –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
   

  

 –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
   

  

 –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
   

  

 Automation \& Change Management:
   

  

 –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Planning \& Execution:
   

  

 –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Partnership:
   

  

 –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
   

  

 Problem Solving:
   

  

 –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
description:
The Head of Enterprise Architecture will act as the custodian of technology architecture for Adani Group, holding end\-to\-end accountability for defining, governing and evolving the Group's technology blueprint across its diversified portfolio of independently operating businesses.
 



 As custodian of architecture across the Group, the role holds the mandate to ensure that technology investments made independently by each business remain strategically aligned, secure, scalable, interoperable, cost\-efficient and designed for reuse. The role chairs the Group Architecture Review Board as the Group's principal governance checkpoint for major technology decisions, and is accountable for the disciplined evaluation of new and emerging technologies before they are adopted at scale.
 



 The role will work closely with Group leadership, Business CDOs/CTOs, the Group CISO and Cyber team, and transformation leaders to evolve the organization from application\-centric technology landscapes toward a platform\-, data\- and API\-driven enterprise architecture.
 



 The role partners closely with the Group's AI Labs, Cloud Engineering and Data organization, aligning their platforms and roadmaps to the wider enterprise architecture, while those functions retain ownership of their respective domains.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the Group's custodian of enterprise architecture: own the Group Enterprise Architecture strategy, principles, standards, reference architectures and the 3–5 year technology roadmap, applied consistently across every Adani Group business.
* Chair the Group Architecture Review Board (ARB) — the central governance body for enterprise technology decisions:
* Set the ARB's review criteria, escalation thresholds and decision rights, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards without slowing day\-to\-day business execution.
* Maintain the ARB as the final sign\-off authority for cross\-business platform, cloud, data and cybersecurity architecture decisions.
* Own the evaluation of new and emerging technologies for the Group:
* Maintain an Enterprise Technology Radar and a documented evaluation framework (business fit, security, cost, interoperability, vendor viability) to assess candidate technologies.
* Systematically move promising technologies — spanning cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, integration, edge and IoT/OT — from evaluation to proof\-of\-concept, production pilot and Group\-wide adoption.
* Act as the final architectural authority on technology and vendor selection decisions referred to the ARB.
* Establish and lead a federated architecture model that provides Group\-level direction while enabling individual businesses — Ports, Airports, Power, Green Energy, Cement, Gas Distribution and Data Centers — to retain appropriate technology autonomy.
* Drive standardization and reuse of platforms, APIs, data products, integration patterns, cloud foundations, identity, observability and common technology services across all Group businesses.
* Establish architecture principles for hybrid cloud, edge computing, high\-performance compute infrastructure, IoT and industrial/OT environments, reflecting the Group's asset\-intensive businesses.
* Drive technology economics and rationalization across the Group, reducing duplicated platforms, unnecessary licenses, technical debt and long\-term total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Build and lead a high\-calibre central Enterprise Architecture team, and develop a federated architecture community of practice across Adani Group businesses.



**Key Success Measures** 




 Success will be measured through Group\-wide business and technology outcomes, including:
 


* Throughput and turnaround time of decisions reviewed by the Architecture Review Board.
* Proportion of new technologies moved from Technology Radar evaluation through PoC to production and Group\-wide scale.
* Increased reuse and reduced duplication of platforms, data products and technical debt across businesses.
* Improved interoperability between business\-unit systems and Group\-level platforms.
* Lower Group\-wide technology TCO and stronger resilience and cybersecurity posture.
* Consistency of security\-by\-design outcomes, validated jointly with the CISO/Cyber team, across ARB decisions.
* Faster, more consistent technology decision\-making across independently operating businesses.



**Candidate Profile** 




 15–20 years of technology experience, with significant leadership responsibility in large and complex enterprises; prior experience chairing or participating in an enterprise architecture review board or equivalent technology governance forum is highly desirable.
 



 Strong experience across enterprise architecture, technology strategy, cloud and infrastructure, enterprise applications/SAP, data platforms, integration, cybersecurity and emerging technology evaluation. Practical understanding of edge computing and modern platform engineering is highly desirable, along with experience partnering with dedicated Cloud Engineering, Data and AI organizations within a large enterprise.
 



 Experience in diversified, infrastructure\-intensive conglomerates spanning sectors such as ports and logistics, energy and utilities, airports, cement and building materials, or data centers would be directly relevant to the scope of this role.
 



 The candidate must combine deep technical credibility, business and commercial understanding, systems thinking, strong executive communication, and the ability to chair cross\-functional governance forums — working closely with Business CDOs/CTOs, the CISO/Cyber team, and specialist AI, Cloud Engineering and Data organizations — to influence technology decisions across independently operating businesses.
